episodes.title: La ley del puerto
episodes.summary: For 30 years, Joaquín Manchado has ruled Barcelona's port with an iron grip — until an unexpected foe threatens his thriving cocaine smuggling business.

episodes.title: Larga vida al rey
episodes.summary: Joaquín's urgency to bring in a new shipment to port grows by the day along with his number of enemies. Román discovers a devastating truth.

episodes.title: Trono de sangre
episodes.summary: The Manchados face an uncertain future as the struggle for power begins. Víctor solidifies his position and a double cross sparks discord among factions.

episodes.title: Doble o nada
episodes.summary: With their enemies circling in, the Manchados' search for the missing shipping containers heats up just as their dynasty fractures from within.

episodes.title: Ojo por ojo, diente por diente
episodes.summary: As Román keeps looking for Ricardo, old family feuds resurface. Víctor receives news that could change the investigation.

episodes.title: Un mal presagio
episodes.summary: Following a lead, Víctor runs into close contact with Miki, who is hot on his trail. Ariel tempts fate. Pressure mounts on money laundering.

episodes.title: Cruce de caminos
episodes.summary: After a double shock, Rocío assumes control of the family business. The stakes rise in Víctor's investigation.

episodes.title: Cuestión de sangre
episodes.summary: A funeral turns into mayhem as Víctor, Néstor and Rocío race to find the missing delivery. A con leaves a life hanging in the balance.
